visuals: A sunny Jordanian desert landscape with rugged rocky hills and the highlands in the background under a clear sky. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Jordan has dry, sunny summers perfect for desert adventures, but winters can get pretty chilly up in the highlands. Better bring both sunscreen and a sweater!

visuals: A person floating effortlessly on the calm, salty waters of the Dead Sea in Jordan, with white salt formations along the shore. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Now for my favorite part: cool natural wonders! Jordan is home to the Dead Sea, the lowest spot on the entire planet. The person floating read a book without even trying. No swimming skills needed!

visuals: The ancient city of Petra in Jordan bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script:
Speaking of bright, Jordan’s national symbol is the Arabian oryx! 
A sleek desert antelope with super pointy horns.

visuals: A small, bright pink Sinai rosefinch bird perched on a rocky desert ledge in Jordan. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Keep your eyes peeled for a rare treat: the Sinai rosefinch, a pink bird that lives in rocky deserts! Yep, pink birds are real!

visuals: A desert lizard resting on a warm rock in the vast, red landscape of Wadi Rum, Jordan. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: But wait, what animals call Jordan home? Besides the oryx and rosefinch, imagine desert lizards.

visuals: A golden jackal prowling through the arid desert hills of Jordan. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Golden jackals, and maybe even a camel or two strutting through Wadi Rum!

visuals: A wide view of central Amman, Jordan, showing the ancient Roman Theater nestled among modern city buildings. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And here’s a brain teaser: What’s the ancient-meets-modern capital of Jordan? Ding, ding… it’s Amman! This city has a giant Roman theater right in its center. Can you picture Gladiator in sandals?

visuals: Snorkeling in the clear waters of the Red Sea near Aqaba, Jordan, with colorful coral reefs and tropical fish. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Other cool cities? Aqaba sits on the Red Sea, a snorkeler’s paradise filled with colorful fish.

visuals: A lively street in the university city of Irbid, Jordan, with students walking past shops and cafes. No text, no signs, no written words.
script:
And in Irbid, students fill the streets.
It’s known for its many universities!

visuals: The Roman Theater in Amman in Jordan bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Arabic is the main language here, but guess what? English pops up a lot in cities and schools. It's a chat-friendly mix for visitors!

visuals: Wadi Rum desert in Jordan bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: About 11 million people live in Jordan! That’s like everyone in Ohio, all in one awesome country!

visuals: A large traditional platter of Jordanian mansaf featuring tender lamb, rice, and pine nuts, served with a creamy yogurt sauce. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Feeling hungry? Let’s dig into Jordan’s tastiest dishes. Mansaf is the national feast! Lamb in creamy yogurt sauce, served during big family gatherings. Yum!

visuals: A breakfast plate in Jordan with crispy falafel, creamy hummus, and warm flatbread served in a sunny outdoor setting. No text, no signs, no written words.
script:
And don’t miss breakfast! In Jordan, crispy falafel and creamy hummus are common eats.
Served with warm bread to scoop it all up. Breakfast of champions, anyone?

visuals: A small table in a Jordanian cafe with glasses of sweet mint tea and small cups of strong cardamom coffee. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Sip time! You might find people drinking strong cardamom coffee or sweet mint tea… usually with friends and long conversations.

visuals: A group of people in a festive Jordanian setting performing the traditional dabke line dance with light and music. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Time to dance! Ever heard of dabke? It’s a lively group dance seen at weddings and big parties. Combine that with Arabic pop, and you’ve got a real celebration!

visuals: The iconic Treasury (Al-Khazneh) of Petra, Jordan, carved directly into the high pink-stone desert cliffs. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And get this… Petra, Jordan’s ancient pink-stone city, is over 2,000 years old! It’s nicknamed the Rose City, and its cave-like buildings are carved right into cliffs. Whoa!

visuals: A soccer ball on a soccer field. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: In 2026, Jordan finally qualified for the World Cup for the first time ever! Fans are celebrating with pride and joy everywhere!

visuals: The Citadel in Amman in Jordan bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Speaking of sports, Ahmad Abughaush made history with Jordan’s first Olympic gold medal in taekwondo!

visuals: Famous Jordanian pianist Zade Dirani performing on a grand piano on an outdoor stage at dusk. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And Zade Dirani, a famous Jordanian pianist, mixes Arabic melodies with music from around the world. A harmony of cultures!

visuals: The breathtaking red sand and sandstone arches of Wadi Rum, Jordan, at sunset, looking like a Martian landscape. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: One last wow? In Wadi Rum, also called the Valley of the Moon, the glowing red sand and stone arches feel like you're walking on another planet. Sci-fi movies actually film there!
